columns.name: run
columns.description: Build and arm key, for example bench_v22_plain_320 (version plus arm).

columns.name: version
columns.description: Build name: bench_v21 to bench_v25, or bench2_v2 to bench2_v9.

columns.name: arm
columns.description: Views the build ran: two_view_320, plain_320 or four_view_320_384.

columns.name: phase
columns.description: parity_reference (reference path on device 0), parity_candidate (one speed configuration on device 0) or main (three studies across both GPUs).

columns.name: config
columns.description: reference = no speed flags. full = every flag the build requested (the flags column is authoritative). single:FLAG = one flag switched on.

columns.name: study_index
columns.description: Position of the study among the three visible studies: 0, 1 or 2. Not a study identifier.

columns.name: stage
columns.description: Stage name. See the stage glossary.

columns.name: seconds
columns.description: Wall-clock seconds for this stage on this study.

columns.name: flags
columns.description: Speed flags in effect, as key=value pairs separated by semicolons: channels_last, chunk (windows per forward call), fused_tta, header_parallel, pixel_parallel, shared_triplets.

columns.name: run
columns.description: Build and arm key, as in timings.csv.

columns.name: version
columns.description: Build name, as in timings.csv.

columns.name: arm
columns.description: Views the build ran, as in timings.csv.

columns.name: phase
columns.description: parity_reference, parity_candidate or main, as in timings.csv.

columns.name: config
columns.description: Configuration name, as in timings.csv.

columns.name: flags
columns.description: Speed flags in effect, as in timings.csv.

columns.name: studies
columns.description: Studies recorded for this run and configuration (three in every case).

columns.name: steady_indices
columns.description: Study indices averaged for the steady-state columns: 1-2 for parity rows, 2 for main-phase rows.

columns.name: study_total_by_index_s
columns.description: study_total_s for each study index, as index:seconds pairs separated by a vertical bar.

columns.name: cold_study0_total_s
columns.description: study_total_s for study index 0 (the cold-start study in parity runs).

columns.name: steady_prep_s
columns.description: Mean CPU prep per steady study: select_s + header_s + pixel_s + volume_s.

columns.name: steady_gpu_s
columns.description: Mean GPU time per steady study: windows_s + full_windows_s + forward_plain_s + forward_mirror_s + forward_fused_s + full_forward_plain_s + full_forward_mirror_s.

columns.name: study_total_scope
columns.description: build+predict (parity rows: prep and GPU timed in one window) or predict_only (main rows: GPU consumer only, prep overlapped).

columns.name: steady_residual_s
columns.description: steady_study_total_s minus steady_prep_s minus steady_gpu_s. Blank for predict_only rows. About 0.01 s in every parity row except the two plain-view reference rows, about 1.9 s (see Timing scope).

columns.name: steady_study_total_s
columns.description: Mean study_total_s over the steady studies.

columns.name: startup_s
columns.description: Startup before the first study (imports, model load, CUDA start), from the receipt.

columns.name: projected_hidden_overlap_s
columns.description: Projected 1,300-study run, overlapped: startup + 1300 x max(prep / 2, gpu / 2).

columns.name: projected_hidden_serial_s
columns.description: Projected 1,300-study run, serial: startup + 1300 x (prep + gpu) / 2.

columns.name: projected_hidden_overlap_prep3x_s
columns.description: As projected_hidden_overlap_s with prep three times larger. A sensitivity check for hidden studies that decode more slowly.

columns.name: parity_passed
columns.description: parity_candidate rows only: whether this configuration passed the parity gate on the visible studies. Blank for other rows.

columns.name: parity_max_abs_dev
columns.description: parity_candidate rows only: largest absolute deviation from the reference probabilities on the visible studies. Gate tolerance is 0.0001. Blank for other rows.

columns.name: accepted
columns.description: parity_candidate rows only: whether this is the configuration the reader accepted for the build. Blank for other rows.

columns.name: gpu_vs_run_reference
columns.description: steady_gpu_s divided by the same build's reference row. 1.0 for reference rows.

columns.name: run
columns.description: Build and arm key, as in timings.csv.

columns.name: version
columns.description: Build name, as in timings.csv.

columns.name: arm
columns.description: Views the build ran, as in timings.csv.

columns.name: has_timing_receipt
columns.description: true if a per-stage timing file for this build is in timings.csv.

columns.name: mode
columns.description: Reader mode (inference).

columns.name: gpu_count
columns.description: GPUs used (two in every run).

columns.name: device_name
columns.description: GPU model reported by the reader (Tesla T4).

columns.name: studies
columns.description: Studies processed (three visible studies).

columns.name: selected_slices
columns.description: Slices selected across the studies.

columns.name: missing_slots
columns.description: Series slots with no usable series across the studies, as counted by the reader.

columns.name: elapsed_s
columns.description: End-to-end wall time of the native run, including startup. Not comparable to per-study totals.

columns.name: startup_s
columns.description: Startup seconds, where the receipt records them. Blank where it does not.

columns.name: fast_decision
columns.description: Gate outcome: accepted_full, accepted_subset (with the accepted flag), or reference_only when no speed flags were requested.

columns.name: fast_config_accepted_name
columns.description: Name of the accepted configuration (full, subset or reference).

columns.name: prep_workers
columns.description: CPU prep workers (two in every run).

columns.name: header_failures
columns.description: DICOM header reads that failed. Zero in every receipt.

columns.name: pixel_failures
columns.description: Pixel reads that failed. Zero in every receipt.

columns.name: study_build_failures
columns.description: Studies whose volume could not be built. Zero in every receipt.

columns.name: model_fallback_studies
columns.description: Studies that fell back to the 0.5 default. Zero in every receipt.

columns.name: fast_fallback_studies
columns.description: Studies that fell back from the speed configuration to the reference. Zero in every receipt.

columns.name: consumer_error_count
columns.description: Errors raised by GPU consumer threads. Zero in every receipt.

columns.name: parity_studies
columns.description: Visible studies used by the parity gate.

columns.name: parity_configs_passed
columns.description: Configurations that passed, as 'passed of tested'.

columns.name: parity_max_abs_dev_passing
columns.description: Largest deviation from the reference over passing configurations. Tolerance is 0.0001.

columns.name: parity_max_abs_dev_all_tested
columns.description: Largest deviation over every tested configuration, passing or not.

columns.name: torch_version
columns.description: PyTorch version recorded by the reader.

columns.name: timm_version
columns.description: timm version recorded by the reader.

columns.name: visible_prediction_sha256
columns.description: SHA-256 that the reader records for its prediction file on the three visible studies. Identical in all 13 native receipts. The snapshot gives the same value as the submission.csv sha256 of three public rows with different scores, so it does not link a receipt to a public row (see Caveats).

columns.name: official_row
columns.description: Public Kaggle row produced by the same notebook version, where the team recorded one. Read as text.

columns.name: official_public_auc
columns.description: Public score of that row, as recorded in the Kaggle submissions snapshot of 2026-10-10.

columns.name: official_note
columns.description: How the row relates to this build.

columns.name: note
columns.description: Context for this build.

columns.name: file
columns.description: Name of the receipt file in this folder, for example receipts__timing__bench_v21_two_view_320.json.

columns.name: kind
columns.description: timing (per-stage timing receipt) or native (native inference receipt).

columns.name: version
columns.description: Build name, as in timings.csv: bench_v21 to bench_v25, or bench2_v2 to bench2_v9.

columns.name: arm
columns.description: Views the build ran, as in timings.csv: two_view_320, plain_320 or four_view_320_384.

select_s.description: Choosing the slices for each series slot from the series metadata.

pixel_s.description: Reading pixel data for the selected slices.

volume_s.description: Per-slot percentile normalisation, centre crop and resize into a 384-pixel volume.

windows_s.description: Building the three-slice windows for the 320-pixel views, including the host-to-device copy.

forward_plain_s.description: Forward pass over the plain windows at 320 px.

forward_mirror_s.description: Forward pass over the mirrored windows at 320 px.

forward_fused_s.description: Plain and mirrored windows in one forward call (fused TTA flag).

full_windows_s.description: Building the 384-pixel full-field triplets, shared by the two full-field passes.

full_forward_plain_s.description: Plain full-field pass at 384 px, including gathering its windows from the shared triplets.

full_forward_mirror_s.description: Mirrored full-field pass at 384 px, including its window gather.

study_total_s.description: Study wall time as recorded by the reader. Scope is in study_total_scope.
